paper.title_en: Exact SU(2) Yang-Mills Waves from a Simple Ansatz
paper.abstract_en: We use an ansatz based on rotations of the Pauli basis to construct exact propagating solutions of the sourceless SU(2) Yang--Mills equations in $(3+1)$ dimensions. By examining and extending this ansatz, we obtain two wave families with nontrivial transverse structures and a family of finite-amplitude waves on a self-similar non-Abelian background. These solutions can retain a genuinely non-Abelian structure while admitting arbitrary wave profiles propagating at the speed of light and carrying the corresponding longitudinal electric or magnetic fields. We also investigate the parameter conditions for their non-Abelian character and their energy transport. For the self-similar family, we study the structure of its singular plane and construct suitable sources to replace the singular region while preserving wave propagation in the remaining regions. This offers a possible interpretation of these solutions as propagating fields outside sources.
